test_title: SSC MTS 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 06 Feb, 2026 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In what ways does the passage explain what “being there” means in mental health care?

options.text: Brief check-ins but not dealing with underlying matters.
Offering consistent support across different kinds of suffering over time.
Overconcern with the basic needs of humans to the point of disregarding the emotional

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• To understand what **"being there"** means, we look at the third sentence: *"It means simply being there for the person, **again and again**, through **various sufferings**..."*
 
• The phrase **"again and again"** implies **consistency** and a long-term commitment over time.
